'''Teemen Alton''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Imperial Knight]] who was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]].<ref name="Legacy 13" /> [[Ania Solo]] was framed for his murder, but in truth the killer was a [[Unidentified masked bounty hunter|masked bounty hunter]] who impersonated the young Solo.<ref name="Legacy 15" />
